scope: Round-one layered Poiseuille study of the frozen two-phase-only approximation. The actual tracked JSON is a two-arm quick snapshot, not the full matrix stated in the historical one-pager and audit. The full-matrix assertion requires at least 15 arms and fails; archived threshold verdict is false. Current scientific acceptance is not evaluated. Retain the legacy study paths until full evidence and compatibility are verified.

archived_predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: 0.15 is the owner band (relative error above 15% is not acceptable). K1 is a semantics/exactness check and is therefore at machine precision. Diagnostics that no threshold can decide a priori (interface width growth, convergence history) are reported as numbers only.

criteria.interpretation: Original thresholds and completeness test unchanged; not satisfied by this quick snapshot.
